WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM riskandmargin
  WHERE ordervault IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordervault
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as sum_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.ordervault, s1.record_count, 
         CAST(s1.record_count AS REAL) / s2.sum_count as ratio
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s2.sum_count IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.ordervault, s3.record_count, s3.ratio,
         s3.record_count - s4.avg_count as difference
  FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
  WHERE s4.avg_count IS NOT NULL
    AND s3.record_count > s4.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(record_count) as total_counts,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratios,
  AVG(difference) as avg_differences
FROM step5
